tidbit: Did you know… about 6,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by Wccftech: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30 GPUs unlock up to 50 to 80 percent more Tensor Core performance for computing tasks with real-world gains up to 60 percent.
Reported by AI Insider: Pathos AI secures $237M in Series E financing to scale its drug development platform and advance four clinical oncology drugs.
An open-source Circle to Search tool skips Gemini and works offline, reported by How-To Geek.
Sweden bans ChatGPT and Claude but approves Microsoft Copilot for government use, reported by KuCoin.
Reported by Washington Examiner: Congress and bureaucrats work to catch up with artificial intelligence, as leaders urge regulation amid fears of rogue systems and drone warfare.
Free every hour.
